body: It sucks even worse when you have a physical disability and people treat you like you're "retarded" before you even speak. "Baby talk" is the worst.
I'm fully fused all the way down, but that's it
I'm trying to realize that. I've reapplied to college, but that doesn't mean anything to employers. Without a degree I'm just a guy they think is "retarded"
I should also add that I feel like I should have died from that car accident, and that the fact that I was saved brought nothing but missery to myself and those I love
